popup.soilLiquefaction.siteCaveat: Site-level results are for preliminary assessment only and do not constitute an engineering safety determination; rely on the official map portal and on-site drilling.
popup.soilLiquefaction.classMeaningText: A composite class the authority derives from boreholes, groundwater level, design earthquake and historical records; it is not a measured value, and PL or groundwater level cannot be back-calculated from it.
popup.soilLiquefaction.notInvestigatedTe: Area not investigated by the authority (including mountains, terraces, reclaimed land, riverbanks and small scattered flats); this does not mean low potential.
popup.soilLiquefaction.noDataText: The source does not provide a potential class (no data); this is neither "not investigated" nor low potential.
popup.soilLiquefaction.noWeakLayer: 0 m (no weak layer in this depth range)
popup.soilLiquefaction.thresholdText: Soft clay is cohesive soil with SPT-N ≤ 4; loose sand is sandy soil with SPT-N ≤ 10.
popup.soilLiquefaction.depthUseText: The 0–5 / 5–10 / 10–20 m ranges correspond to different excavation reference depths; thickness is the total weak layer within that range, not over the full depth.
popup.soilLiquefaction.gridLimits: The grid is for preliminary assessment only and does not constitute an engineering safety determination. {caveat}
popup.soilLiquefaction.siteLimits: Only station location and name are provided, not real-time readings; see the official page for monitoring data.
